experiments.protocol: causal GMT OFF tracking; independent per-scene banks and RNG; online optional TRAIN head features used only for retrieval
experiments.temporal_scope: within-scene cameras synchronized by dataset frame_id; unrelated scenes interleaved by ordinal replay round, no physical cross-scene synchronization claim
experiments.query_scope: every current detector target at fixed query interval; all other camera clips including unrelated scene distractors; no GT selection
experiments.latency_scope: local in-process query scoring and response serialization; no HTTP/network latency claim; full rounds charge reads, detector, GTA, extraction, CPU publication, queries and log I/O
